sources.name: UgNLIS — Bulegeni Town Council cadastral parcels
sources.scope: Published parcel boundaries accessible through Bulegeni Town Council (cad_twc_bulegeni), Bulambuli county, Mbale cadastral district. Observed parcels are 1–2 km northwest of the immutable Buligenyi queue point. Partial bounded coverage; exact-point and citywide completeness, currentness and Buligenyi/Bulegeni naming/boundary alignment remain unestablished.

caveats: Enumerates published block/plot selectors and serves their usable boundaries; complete query results describe this published selector scope, never citywide cadastral completeness.
Records without published geometry are counted and excluded from map results. Exact reads of such records report boundary unavailability.
Native numeric/UUID IDs are located by selector enumeration, then freshly re-read and checked against the native ID. No owner, address or title details are retained.
WGS84 coordinates use EPSG:21096 and Arc 1960 to WGS 84 (1), published accuracy 35 m; survey alignment and provider datum realization remain second-pass follow-ups.

The portal build declares EPSG:21096 and native metre coordinates are consistent with easting,northing; independent survey alignment and provider datum realization remain unestablished. No fitted offsets, geometry repair, clipping or rounding are applied.
